title: Ideal (lean): why question, note change with reason, hold, Nina now and next few, hold, bye
goal: Speak in SHORT natural lines (one short sentence). Say only the scored moves. Part 1: do NOT agree to stay late. Ask 'Why do you think they keep calling in again?' After the woman's story, go straight to the note change with the reason: 'Write down what customers already tried, so they don't have to call again.' When he pushes ('even when it's busy?') say 'Yes, even then.' Part 3: when Marcus says he'd like Nina's help but doesn't want to bother her, say 'Have Nina sit in on your calls. Today, and the next few.' When he says she has her own calls, say 'I'll talk to her and free up her time.' Then say 'Bye.'

intents.do: Clear note change plus reason, right away
